summary: The IBOGAINE Act aims to speed up the development of, and access to, psychedelic drugs like ibogaine for treating serious mental illnesses. It creates a pilot voucher program for national health priority products, adjusts Drug Enforcement Administration manufacturing quotas and scheduling rules for certain substances, updates right-to-try laws for schedule I investigational drugs, and mandates various reports, partnerships, and Department of Veterans Affairs programs regarding emerging therapeutic interventions.

affected_groups.effect: Eligible to receive priority review vouchers under a pilot program and apply for expedited mid-year adjustments of manufacturing quotas.
Can apply for special registration with the Attorney General to directly administer schedule I eligible investigational drugs under right-to-try laws.
Impacted by VA reports, workforce readiness plans, and programs regarding emerging therapeutic interventions and psychedelic-assisted therapies.
Required to handle new voucher systems, adjust quotas, conduct interagency collaborations, issue rulemakings, and submit reports to Congress.

key_provisions: Establishes a National Health Priority Voucher Pilot Program at the FDA, running until September 30, 2029, to award priority review vouchers for qualifying medical products.

Amends federal right-to-try laws to exempt eligible investigational drugs in schedule I from prohibitions under the Controlled Substances Act, and sets up a special registration process for physicians to administer them.

Requires the Attorney General to revise annual production quotas for schedule I and II controlled substances within specified days after certain triggering events, such as FDA approvals or phase 3 clinical trials.
Authorizes HHS, through specific agencies, to partner with states, territories, and Indian Tribes to advance research and development of psychedelic drugs like ibogaine.
Directs the Attorney General to take steps within 60 days of enactment to determine whether to transfer ibogaine and ibogaine compounds from schedule I to schedule II.
Mandates the Department of Veterans Affairs to designate a senior official for emerging therapeutic interventions, submit periodic reports, and develop a workforce readiness and training plan.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or appropriations authorized to carry out the programs described in the bill.
Detailed criteria for how the Secretary will determine user fee exact amounts beyond general guidelines.
Specific clinical outcomes or safety data for ibogaine, as the bill focuses on accelerating its study and regulatory pathways rather than establishing definitive medical efficacy.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The IBOGAINE Act aims to speed up the development of, and access to, psychedelic drugs like ibogaine for treating serious mental illnesses. It creates a pilot voucher program for national health priority products, adjusts Drug Enforcement Administration manufacturing quotas and scheduling rules for certain substances, updates right-to-try laws for schedule I investigational drugs, and mandates various reports, partnerships, and Department of Veterans Affairs programs regarding emerging therapeutic interventions.
summary_detail.significance: The bill represents a moderate-to-substantial policy shift by creating expedited regulatory pathways, manufacturing quota adjustments, and special right-to-try provisions specifically aimed at incorporating psychedelic drugs and other priority medical treatments into regular clinical use and research.
